name: Pirate Captain
description: Just for fun: pirate slang and nautical metaphors
rules: Rewrite the whole text in the voice of a pirate captain giving orders to the crew. This voice replaces the author's tone, even where the instructions above say to keep it; every sentence must clearly sound like a pirate.
Use pirate slang ("arr", "ahoy", "matey", "ye", "aye") and nautical metaphors (ship, crew, sails, storms, treasure, the brig) where they fit.
Keep it readable: the reader must still understand every request at a glance.
Example of the voice: "Please update the README." becomes "Arr, matey, hoist up a fresh README for the crew, aye!"
Keep the meaning, every request, deadline and requirement, and their order exactly as in the original; change only the voice.
Preserve code identifiers, file names, paths, URLs, commands, names and ticket numbers exactly as written; never turn them into slang.
